metadata.title: Clicked like I was panicking and Valorant said ‘Yeah, sure, why not?’
metadata.description:
That moment when your panic click somehow gets a kill.
Enemy probably wondering if I’m cheating or just lucky.
Valorant logic: handing out mercy kills when you least expect it.
If your aim’s a mystery but kills still come, tap in!

Tap if you’ve ever panic-clicked your way to a kill!

#valorant #luckykill #gamingfails #funnygaming #shorts

Instagram: @ganpatigamerboi
